comments.value: ive been wanting a feature like this for a while now.

Looks a lot like this 
https://vrchat.canny.io/feature-requests/p/mailbox-messaging-system
but it's much better. 

I'm still extremely surprised we don't have it yet.

author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

comments.value: I would love to be able to text a friend in VRChat and not having to rely on 3rd party platforms like Discord. I think it would definitely be beneficial for standalone users as well as PC users in case your friends are busy in another world. Having to rely on invite and request invite messages in order to communicate with one another is very inconvenient, especially since each invite message takes 30 minutes to update.

details: Ever want to know what your friend is doing in another world but dont want to leave the room your in? "Hey how long are you going to be?" "Ill be over in 5 minutes" Also when your texting a friend a cell phone pops out in front of your Avatar to indicate to others that you are texting.
title: Text Other players/ Plus animation.
